title: C3 AI Announces New Employee Inducement Grants
summary: C3 AI is an Enterprise AI application software company enabling organizations worldwide to develop, deploy, and operate AI at scale.
body_markdown:
REDWOOD CITY, Calif. — September 25, 2026 — C3 AI (the “Company”) (NYSE: AI), the Enterprise AI application software company, today announced that it granted restricted stock unit (“RSU”) awards under its 2025 Inducement Plan (the “Inducement Plan”) to four new employees.


Effective September 14, 2026, C3 AI’s Compensation Committee of the Board of Directors approved restricted stock unit awards to four employees covering, in the aggregate, 1,230,000 shares of Class A common stock (the “RSU Awards”). Such awards were granted as a material inducement in accordance with the employment inducement award exemption under the NYSE Listed Company Manual Section 303A.08.


The RSU Awards are generally subject to quarterly vesting over a 5-year period with a 1-year cliff vest for the first year, with certain of the awards subject to acceleration of vesting under certain circumstances. The RSU Awards are otherwise subject to the terms and conditions of the Inducement Plan and the terms and conditions of the relevant restricted stock unit award agreement covering such award.


**About C3 AI**


C3 AI is the Enterprise AI application software company. C3 AI delivers a family of fully integrated products including the C3 Agentic AI Platform, an end-to-end platform for developing, deploying, and operating enterprise AI applications, C3 AI applications, a portfolio of industry-specific SaaS enterprise AI applications that enable the digital transformation of organizations globally, and C3 Generative AI, a suite of domain-specific generative AI offerings for the enterprise.
